snippet.title: PlayStation - Castlevania Chronicles (2001)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Count Dracula has been resurrected to begin a new reign of terror across the land. As Simon Belmont, descendant of legendary vampire hunters, you enter Dracula's estate to face the Count and his minions - alone. Be prepared for one of the first adventures in the Castlevania series ever!
